agyos_skill.intent: Azure Event Hubs SDK for Rust. Use for sending and receiving events, streaming data ingestion.
agyos_skill.instructions: Client library for Azure Event Hubs — big data streaming platform and event ingestion service. ```sh cargo add azure_messaging_eventhubs azure_identity ``` ```bash EVENTHUBS_HOST=<namespace>.servicebus.windows.net EVENTHUB_NAME=<eventhub-name> ``` - **Namespace** — container for Event Hubs - **Event Hub** — stream of events partitioned for parallel processing - **Partition** — ordered sequence of events - **Producer** — sends events to Event Hub - **Consumer** — receives events from partitions ```rust use azure_identity::DeveloperToolsCredential; use azure_messaging_eventhubs::ProducerClient; let credential = DeveloperToolsCredential::new(None)?; let producer = ProducerClient::builder() .open("<namespace>.servicebus.windows.net", "eventhub-name", credential.clone()) .await?; ``` ```rust producer.send_event(vec![1, 2, 3, 4], None).await?; ``` ```rust
